outcome: Report numbers stored as text that are compared as text (GAPS G25): a successful transform whose filter or derive orders a text column against a quoted number carries a numbers_compared_as_text signal when the column's values are numbers that fall on the other side of the comparison as numbers, with the request rewritten to compare them as numbers.
criteria: A transform_dataset or materialize_result whose filter or derive compares a text column with a quoted number by <, <=, > or >= succeeds and carries numbers_compared_as_text advice when every non-blank value of that column parses as a number and at least one of them compares differently as a number; the explanation names the column, the comparison, how many values differ and one of them.

When the comparison is found in the request as written, the advice carries a rewrite comparing try_cast(column as double) with the number; sent back, the rewrite succeeds and returns the rows a numeric comparison selects (tested).
No such advice is given when the column holds a non-blank value that is not a number, when no value compares differently, or when the column is numeric; the tests use data unrelated to any benchmark.
README.md (Failure semantics and section 7 item 1) and the recovery module's docstring name the new signal, and MADR 0010 carries a Decision History entry recording it.

dispositions.note: weight > '100000000' over a JSON text column (99999999, 100000000, 250000000, blank) succeeds with numbers_compared_as_text naming lots.weight, the comparison, '1 of its values falls on the other side' and '99999999'; a derive comparison and a materialize_result carry it too.

the rewrite reads try_cast(weight as double) > 100000000 (and 100000000 < try_cast(weight as double) for a quoted number on the left); sent back it returns only lot C; materialize_result's rewrite keeps the first result and names the new one heavy_lots_numeric.
silent for weight > '1' (text and numbers agree), for a column holding 'A10', and for the numeric orders.amount; the tests use invented lot weights and bins.
README Failure semantics now names three signals, section 7 item 1 lists numbers_compared_as_text, the recovery module docstring says three, and MADR 0010 has a 2026-09-25 history entry.

note: One engine scan per flagged comparison (compare_text_as_number counts non-numbers and disagreeing values); comparisons are only looked for in filters and derives, against source columns that still carry a column id, at most four per transform. Sorting and min/max over numbers stored as text are the same mistake and are not covered.
